description: This file contains utility functions for retrieving and enriching user session data, including fetching user info from session, handling profile authorization, and constructing user objects with metadata and organization info.

methods.name: getUserFromSession
methods.description: Fetches and enriches user data from session, including profile and organization info.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves server session using request context.

methods.name: getUserSession
methods.description: Gets user and session info, verifies profile authorization, and constructs session object with upId.
